ideas.pitch: A web platform that predicts harmful algal bloom risk in local water bodies 3-5 days in advance using machine learning.
ideas.title: BurgasBay Algal Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses climate and ocean intelligence with a proven hackathon-winning architecture and clear predictive value for marine environments.

ideas.pitch: An image-classification mobile app that instantly detects crop diseases and food security risks from smartphone photos.
ideas.title: AgriSnapp Mobile Classifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Agriculture track by solving immediate yield protection problems using mobile-first image recognition.

ideas.pitch: A digital agriculture dashboard that tracks soil health metrics and optimizes water usage for smallholder farmers.
ideas.title: Prakriti Digital Ag Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the Cornell Grand Prize winner pattern of combining agronomy data with a polished, actionable interface.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered agriculture platform offering crop disease detection with 92 percent accuracy alongside offline SMS market price alerts.
ideas.title: AgriConnect SMS & AI Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features robust offline accessibility which heavily appeals to judges evaluating practical adoption in rural agricultural contexts.

ideas.pitch: A spatial farm defense network predicting agricultural weather drift using OpenWeather APIs, Neo4j spatial indexing, and voice commands.
ideas.title: AgriHive Spatial Defense
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines advanced spatial data mapping with modern voice interfaces, meeting high-tech expectations for climate and agricultural intelligence.
